evidence.quote: Licensed firms are required to submit STRs to the JFIU via STREAMS 2 by one of the following means:
(a)  submission of an STR in an Extensible Markup Language (XML) format3;
(b)  uploading a completed STR form in the prescribed PDF format3; or
(c)  completing the web-based STR form in STREAMS 2.
Hongkong Post e-Cert (electronic certificate) is required for this submission.

issues.explanation: Footnote 3 and both anchors are supplied. Licensed firms using XML or prescribed PDF submissions require Hongkong Post e-Cert. The assembled inventory leaves this material qualification unresolved and disconnected from both options. The web-form option has no footnote 3 marker; this text does not impose the requirement on that option.

evidence.quote: With effect from 2 February 2026, STREAMS 2 will become the only channel for filing STRs2.
upon the launch of STREAMS 2 at 9:00am on 2 February 2026, the operation of STREAMS will be discontinued.
For STRs submitted to the JFIU via channels other than STREAMS 2 following its implementation, licensed firms are required to re-submit the STRs via STREAMS 2.
licensed corporations, SFC-licensed virtual asset service providers and associated entities (collectively referred to as “licensed firms”)

issues.explanation: Footnote 2 supplies the qualification to exclusivity: post-implementation submissions through other channels require re-submission through STREAMS 2. It does not authorize those channels as alternatives. Firm classification and launch timing are supplied elsewhere in the packet, so the corresponding missing-context assertions and complete-document dependency are stale. Preserve the blackout separately; this footnote does not expressly require re-submission of pre-launch blackout reports.

evidence.quote: 1 STREAMS 2 was introduced by the JFIU during the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Financing of Terrorism Webinar held on 17 and 18 November 2025. The presentation material is accessible on the SFC website

issues.explanation: Footnote 1 is supplied, contrary to the claim uncertainty and authority entry. Only the referenced presentation remains uninspected. The webinar introduction dates do not replace the February 2026 launch date.

evidence.quote: for any STRs requiring urgent submission during the blackout period of STREAMS, please contact the JFIU directly
The JFIU will provide guidance to facilitate the re-submission.

issues.explanation: Internal references to c11, c12, p1-c1 and p1-c3 do not resolve to existing claim IDs. Replace them with the existing IDs for blackout timing, urgent contact, re-submission and triggering timing respectively. These broken links obscure material exceptions and dependencies despite the underlying claims being present.

unresolved_questions: What procedures and deadlines, if any, does the referenced JFIU re-submission guidance prescribe, including treatment of blackout submissions?
What requirements appear in the separately provided XML schema and prescribed PDF specification?
Which authorities do the opaque missing.* dependency identifiers represent? The supplied packet does not establish their mappings.
The source does not expressly identify the time zone for the blackout and launch times.
